# TDrive v3.0.9

This update improves iPhone video playback compatibility and simplifies the downloader's quality choices.

## iPhone video downloads

- Select a video-only H.264 stream before adding one AAC audio stream, avoiding an unintended extra audio track in the MP4.
- Show compatible quality presets first. Move detailed extractor formats into a collapsed **All formats** list and hide unavailable presets.
- Replace raw numeric format notes with clear video/audio labels.

Existing downloads are unchanged. Download the video again after updating TDrive to use the corrected format selection.
